definitions: A role responsible for maximizing the value of the product resulting from the work of the development team, with a strong emphasis on the technical aspects of the product.
An individual who bridges the gap between business needs and technical implementation, guiding the development of a product from a technical perspective.
examples: The Technical Product Owner prioritized the API development.
She is the Technical Product Owner for the new platform.
Our Technical Product Owner ensured the system's scalability.
